title: Encyclopaedia Britannica - Seventh edition, Volume 15, MEY-Navigation - EB.15
text: The result of the researches of Daubeny and others on the subject of the tertiary igneous producers, is to connect them, in a very particular manner, with the history of ex- tincts and active volcanoes of later date. In some instances it may be admitted that igneous action, which existed in the tertiary area, has been continued almost a historical times (Auvvergne), or even to this day (Etua).
